scope: TB-L6 boundary and initialization contract adoption only
existing_registry_note: ATB-BND-001 remains an untouched TB01 adapter candidate. This fragment does not inherit its broader wording across zero, subthreshold and active domains; it records only evidence-bounded contracts and gaps.

entries.claim: For the qualified exact-zero-throughflow atom with Hetop>0, the upper reservoir retains incoming load in storage according to the zero-flow limit Hetop*C1 = Hetop*C0 + St*Load; the natural isolated probe preserves all prior records and confines first differences to predeclared upper-boundary coordinates.
entries.boundary_sign_contract: Load is positive into the upper-reservoir control volume; throughflow is exactly zero for this atom.
entries.failure_semantics: Loss of nonzero incoming load from represented end storage, or any difference outside the declared direct coordinates in the pinned natural probe, fails the narrow contract.

entries.claim: For 0<Flux<1.0d-8 with Flpn=0, the upper-boundary seam is naturally reachable and numerically material, but no replacement threshold, P-switch, series order, expm1 policy or scientific tolerance has been admitted.
entries.failure_semantics: Fail closed: the exact-zero boundary contract must not be extended into the finite-positive subthreshold domain without separate numerical-policy qualification.

entries.claim: HETOP=0 is parser- and documentation-admissible but its global concentration semantics are not uniquely recoverable; no zero-thickness model policy is selected.
entries.failure_semantics: Fail closed: do not infer a zero-thickness concentration or initialization policy and do not silently widen BND-002 to HETOP=0.

entries.claim: For the qualified GHG bottom-air boundary contract, the lower external advective air flux Flair(Nl+1) is zero for the closed lower GHG air boundary; compiler-provided uninitialized values are not model semantics.
entries.boundary_sign_contract: Downward external advective air flux is positive; the qualified closed lower boundary value is exactly zero.
entries.failure_semantics: Any dependence of the first boundary read on uninitialized compiler or stack state fails the initialization contract; this entry does not itself admit a production fix.

entries.source_identity: ANIMO-TB01 TB-L6 coverage gap plus bounded UBQ/BUILDQ evidence
entries.claim: A complete cold-start/restart initialization and boundary matrix across upper, lower, deposition, crop, GHG, macropore and management-transition surfaces is not yet qualified.
entries.failure_semantics: Fail closed: no whole-model boundary or initialization qualification may be inferred from BND-002 or BND-005.
